## Problem and scope

Describe the problem, intended outcome, and explicit boundaries of this change.

## Implementation

Summarize the important behavior and trade-offs. Identify changes to workflow,
supervision, safety, persistence, or public contracts.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant automated tests were executed and passed.
- [ ] Zero matching tests, skipped tests, and tests not executed are reported explicitly.
- [ ] Manual testing is concrete and executable, or marked Not Applicable with a reason.
- [ ] Type checking and build status are reported.
- [ ] Visible changes include public-safe screenshots when useful.

Commands and observed results:

```text
command -> observed result
```

## Review follow-up

- [ ] Greptile completed review of the current head; review link and commit are recorded.
- [ ] Findings have verified fixes or reasoned dispositions; follow-ups are linked.
- [ ] Required checks pass on the current head. Pending or unavailable review is reported explicitly.

Follow [the review procedure](https://github.com/aboimpinto/AgenticDevelopmentProcess/blob/master/docs/contributing/pr-review.md).

## Safety and publication

- [ ] No credentials, private project material, personal paths, runtime databases, or raw agent sessions are included.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied material have compatible licences.
- [ ] Destructive, migration, compatibility, and rollback implications are documented.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed below.

## AI assistance

Describe which agents or models materially contributed and how their work was independently checked.
